integrity: Proof is analytic; equality by explicit construction. Finite checks are supplemental. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
limitations: No estimate for general non-flat positive spectral values of the real part; no classification of nonnormal equality cases; possibility of older equivalent unindexed inequality remains.
scientific_scope: Bounded operators on arbitrary complex Hilbert spaces with real-part absolute value a scalar multiple of a projection; sharp exact imaginary-part norm profile under one-sided modulus defect.
title: Sharp square-root Fong–Tsui stability for flat-modulus real parts
